display_title: HORIZON-MISS-2027-01-CLIMA-02 Researching and applying the potential of Artificial Intelligence to foster climate resilience at the regional and local levels – Horizon Europe
call_title: Supporting the implementation of the Adaptation to Climate Change Mission (HORIZON-MISS-2027-01)
call_module_title: HORIZON-MISS-2027-01-CLIMA-02 Researching and applying the potential of Artificial Intelligence to foster climate resilience at the regional and local levels
executive_summary: Researches AI tools for more accessible local climate data or sector-specific adaptation. The second objective explicitly permits energy-system resilience and expects private-sector expertise. Eligible consortia can include private-sector experts in the sectoral adaptation route. The topic budget is EUR 12 million, with around EUR 3 million expected per project. Opening 2027-02-09. Full proposal deadline 2027-09-21 at 17:00 Brussels time.
status_rationale: Missions Work Programme, pp. 61–63, describes the eligible work in Scope. Annex B permits a Dutch funded beneficiary and Objective 2 explicitly calls for relevant private-sector actors. TenneT could build and validate a grid resilience application across the required authorities' territories. This supports Type 1 and C1.3. Both project dates are null because the call states no start, end or duration.
